notes:
Account summary: Ridgehaven Strategic Command (Ridgehaven Transit Authority) evaluating Redwood Private for regulated on-prem/offline inference. Primary goal: operational dispatch augmentation + automated incident summarization across control center logs.

Key constraints / requirements: 
- Must be fully air-gapped: no outbound telemetry, no third-party cloud egress.
- Key management: customer-controlled KMS/HSM required; Redwood must support importable keys and local HSM driver.
- Audit & retention: detailed per-request audit logs forwarded to on-prem Splunk; retention policy 5+ years for security logs.
- Identity: SSO via SAML + RBAC integration with existing IAM.
- Compliance: require SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence; security team flagged potential CJIS considerations if we integrate police dispatch later.
- Performance targets: median latency <= 250ms for short-format dispatch queries, peak concurrent throughput ~50 req/s during incidents; acceptable degradation policy: automatic fallback to smaller quantized variant.
- Model preference: prefer vetted open models (Llama-family or Redwood-verified) with INT8/4 quantization profiles. Must allow pinning model versions and offline model uploads.

POC plan (agreed in principle):
- 2-week on-site air-gapped POC (sandboxed Rack) using synthetic dispatch logs + redacted real incidents. Evaluate latency, token-cost profile, KV cache behavior with rolling sequences.
- Deliverables: performance report, audit log sample, installer runbook, HSM integration checklist, cost estimate for 12-month reserved capacity.

Sales/technical notes (shorthand):
- "We cannot allow any telemetry to leave our network" - L. Moreno (Head, Control Center).
- Security team: want to run installer vetting (checksum + reproducible build) and request signed attestation.
- Procurement: target decision window Q1-Q2 2026 but need procurement lead time 8-10 weeks.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-high; willing to pay premium for guaranteed isolation + support SLAs.

Open questions / risks:
- HSM integration: which HSM vendors in their data center? (awaiting asset list).
- Rack/VM specs: they sent preliminary hardware list but SRE needs Redwood's recommended baseline for 75th percentile load.
- Legal: data residency policy clause for incident transcripts when shared with state agencies.

Next actions assigned:
- SE (Daniel) compile on-prem installer checklist + signed build guidance (due 2026-02-17).
- AE (Aisha) coordinate on-site security workshop scheduling and SOW revisions.
- Security (Redwood) provide SOC2/ISO evidence pack and reference architecture for air-gapped install.
